basics.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer (AI Agents, Tech Lead)
basics.name: Stevan Pavlović
basics.workRights: Serbian citizen, based in Belgrade. Available immediately. Open to B2B contracts or employment.

contributions.description: Co-founded the company in October 2022 and have owned its technical strategy since the first plan: backend, frontend, infrastructure and, since 2025, the AI products. I interview engineers and lead hiring.

Since September 2025, lead a team of five that builds AI voice agents, workflow automation and fleet optimization for trucking companies, built mostly with Claude, using harness and context engineering.

Set the architecture of the fleet safety platform on Node.js, NestJS and Redis, from the mobile driver apps through real-time Redis pub/sub ingestion to the live operations dashboards: pre-trip inspections, accident reports, driver scorecards and compliance documents.

Built most of the app frontend. Moved safetyrealtime.com from Next.js to Astro: shipped JavaScript fell from about 142 KB to 2.5 KB gzipped per page. PageSpeed mobile performance 98 to 100, LCP 1.8 s, CLS 0 and SEO 100, measured with Lighthouse and web-vitals. I own its structured data, sitemaps and indexing.

Led the architecture of the FundedBettor betting project and a multi-tenant casino project. Built 167Pluto's first event-driven system: NestJS and Kafka services for the bet lifecycle, odds and settlement, with tuned Kafka topics and streaming.
Set up the React architecture of the real-time betting platform and led its move from Next.js to TanStack Router, for a smaller, faster bundle and fully typed routes and search params.

Made the settlement pipeline replay-safe with idempotency keys. Added staged rollouts and automated canary analysis for zero-downtime deployments through peak sporting events, plus tracing, structured logs and latency dashboards for faster incident diagnosis.

Led a team of three placed with TCP on Humanity.com, a workforce management platform with hundreds of thousands of users. Contributed to its backend-for-frontend layer in Node.js and NestJS: one endpoint replaced 3 to 5 upstream API calls.
Owned the caching: Redis cache-aside with TTL invalidation and Redis tuning, plus circuit breakers that serve cached or partial data when upstreams slow down.
Decoupled frontend and backend releases through stable, versioned OpenAPI contracts.
Built automated video transcoding pipelines on AWS for a healthcare education platform, with idempotent retries, traceable state transitions and audit logging.

Made the case to the CTO for rewriting the Symfony 4 core-banking monolith in NestJS, then architected Syllo, the new service layer: bounded contexts, typed gRPC and Protobuf contracts, event-driven flows over Kafka and Redis, deployed on Kubernetes. First monolith parts moved within 5 months.
Added double-entry style balance checks and idempotent handlers on money-moving service boundaries.

Led a team of two engineers across backend and frontend, set the engineering standards, advised the DevOps engineer, and mentored the team through the move to Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS and event-driven design.

Worked for Catena Media on AskGamblers.com, an iGaming review platform with 150,000+ registered users and hundreds of thousands of monthly visits: split legacy Symfony modules into cleaner service boundaries and cut resource use by up to 90% on high-load paths.
Tuned response times and cache strategy on the SEO-critical public pages, and removed PostgreSQL and Redis bottlenecks.

Architected Intelligent Admissions, the Decision451 module of the Element451 higher-education CRM: rule-based scoring in PHP and Laravel over hundreds of properties per application, triggering enrollment workflows for 20+ partner institutions and hundreds of thousands of admissions.
Built PHP (Laravel, Symfony) and Node.js backends for agency clients, including webshops from scratch, shared libraries for recurring patterns, and parts of the in-house deployment tooling.
Built a custom CMS in object-oriented PHP and JavaScript, and full-stack websites for clients in Serbia.
AI voice agents, workflow automation and fleet optimization for trucking fleets, built mostly with Claude.
NestJS services with gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka, Redis and Kubernetes.
One endpoint replaced 3 to 5 upstream calls, with Redis cache-aside and circuit breakers.
One public setup for three AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Opencode): 19 skills, 8 agents, and a Rust guard that enforces written rules on agent tool calls.
Personal site on Astro, React and three.js, with an MCP server on a Cloudflare Worker that gives AI agents 8 tools to read my profile, experience, skills and projects.

summary: Software engineer with 11 years in backend and frontend: Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, React, Kafka, PostgreSQL and Redis, across fintech, betting, healthtech and fleet logistics. Co-founder and part-time CTO of Safety Real Time: I have owned its technical strategy since 2022, and since September 2025 I lead a team of five that builds AI voice agents for trucking fleets. Ten engineers have reported to me directly across three companies. I build with AI coding agents and care about evals and correctness.
